"I want to get outdoors more" is what @sherryberryjp said to me a few months back!! And so we went out and did a day of ADVENTURE comparing her wheelchair to one from @struttofficial (thank you so much by the way!) and a Beach wheelchair that I won't link because quite frankly, while the experience was great, some of the staff at the event lead to a less-than-pleasant experience that I wouldn't want any of you to have to struggle with. But the day itself was absolutely amazing, and now Sherry is saying she wants to try out an actual exoskeleton! So.... We're saving for that! Also yes - I have a pet pigeon now!
#Japan #Wheelchair #wheelchairlife #Tokyo
